After departure, a kind reminder for busy families
It concerns the desk

Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways will review post-departure reports and help guide the next steps for pets and carriers.

If a crate is missing, submit the report at once and keep your travel papers ready. <<FACT F118>> Staff will record each service change in the desk ledger, and the senior coordinator will guide any review with care and calm. Provide clear notes about the animal, the crate, and any handling concerns so the desk can trace the matter without delay.

For cabin overheating, keep the animal under close watch and follow the crew's instructions. <<FACT F111>> Care plans are arranged for species, temperament, and comfort, and the desk will use those details when it reviews the situation. If you need support after landing, bring any relevant papers and speak with staff in a calm, direct way.

Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for further help and guidance.
